sentences.text:
Ms. Lily Sahay, A.P.P.
---
04 / 16.04.2024 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Giridih Cyber P.S. Case No. 37 of 2023 for the offences registered under sections 413/414/419/ 420/ 467/ 468/ 471/ 201/120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 66(B)/ 66(C) / 66(D) of Information Technology Act, pending in the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II-cum-Special Judge, Cyber Case, Giridih..

entities.text: Giridih Cyber P.S. Case No. 37 of 2023
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-II-cum-Special Judge, Cyber Case, Giridih
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. On 06.12.2023, Cyber Police, Giridih on the basis of confidential information, raided the house of one Shamshad Ansari and apprehended him and co-accused Salamat Ansari.
On search, large number of mobile phones and e-gadgets were recovered from there.
On the basis of confession of the apprehended accused persons, house of the petitioner was also raided and mobile phone was recovered from his possession.
4. It was submitted that the prosecution has not produced any witness to show the petitioner had cheated him to make out a case of cyber crime against him.
It was further submitted that similarly situated co-accused persons have been granted bail by this court earlier.

5. Considering the aforesaid facts, petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II-cum-Special Judge, Cyber Case, Giridih in connection with Giridih Cyber P.S. Case No. 37 of 2023.
